text:
SVEN HIRSCH AND YIPENG WANG
arXiv:2604.26046v1 [math.DG] 28 Apr 2026

Abstract. We give a counterexample to a recently conjectured variant
                                                  of the Penrose inequality.

chapter: ON A VARIANT OF THE PENROSE CONJECTURE
text:
Theorem 3 essentially shows that any Penrose-type inequality must either
be formulated in terms of area(Σ) or depend on more than the intrinsic
geometry of Σ, as in the mass-p-capacity inequalities [2, 1].

Acknowledgments. The authors would like to thank S.-T. Yau for helpful
discussions and for his interest in this work.
